title: Fix non-functional submit button and comment list creation in Admin Panel

requirements.summary: Fix the 'Choose a list...' button in the 'Create New Comment List' section so that clicking it successfully creates a new comment list with the entered name and triggers the backend storage operation
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the 'Choose a list...' button with a valid list name creates the comment list
The button click handler properly triggers the form submission
Backend successfully stores the new comment list
User receives visual feedback (success message or loading state) during creation

file_operations.description: Fix the button click handler in the 'Create New Comment List' section. Replace the 'Choose a list...' button with a proper submit button element (type='button' or type='submit') that correctly binds to the createList mutation. Ensure the onClick handler calls the createCommentList mutation with the entered list name. Add proper disabled state during mutation loading. Add visual feedback (loading spinner or disabled state) during the creation operation. Verify the component re-renders correctly after successful creation.

requirements.summary: Make newly created comment lists automatically appear in the 'Manage Existing Lists' dropdown immediately after creation without requiring a page refresh
acceptanceCriteria: After creating a list like 'App7', it immediately appears in the 'Select List' dropdown under 'Manage Existing Lists'
The dropdown updates without requiring manual refresh
React Query cache is invalidated to fetch the updated list

file_operations.description: In the useCreateCommentList mutation's onSuccess callback, ensure the React Query cache for 'availableCommentLists' is invalidated using queryClient.invalidateQueries. This will trigger a refetch of the available lists and update the dropdown immediately after successful creation.

Ensure the 'Select List' dropdown in the 'Manage Existing Lists' section properly subscribes to the availableCommentLists query and re-renders when the query data changes. Verify that the dropdown component's options are dynamically bound to the query result.

requirements.summary: Fix all button click event handlers throughout the Admin Panel to ensure they respond properly when clicked in production deployment
acceptanceCriteria: All buttons in the Admin Panel respond to click events
Click handlers execute their intended actions consistently
No console errors related to event handler binding
Buttons work identically in both draft and production environments

file_operations.description: Review all button elements for proper event handler binding. Ensure onClick handlers are correctly bound using arrow functions or proper this context. Replace any non-interactive elements (divs, spans) styled as buttons with actual button elements. Add explicit type='button' attributes to prevent unintended form submissions. Verify all mutation hooks are properly called within click handlers.

Review the send message button for proper event handler binding. Ensure the onClick handler correctly calls the addChatMessage mutation. Add type='button' or type='submit' as appropriate. Verify the button is not accidentally disabled or has CSS preventing pointer events.

Review delete buttons for rating images. Ensure onClick handlers correctly call the deleteRatingImage mutation with the proper image index. Add type='button' to prevent form submission behavior. Verify buttons are properly enabled and have correct event propagation.

Review all buttons for creating/deleting apps, adding usernames, and reset operations. Ensure onClick handlers are properly bound and call the correct mutations. Add type='button' attributes. Verify no CSS is blocking pointer events or making buttons appear disabled when they should be enabled.

Review buttons for setting and resetting the bulk generator key. Ensure onClick handlers correctly call the respective mutations. Add type='button' attributes. Verify proper event binding and no CSS interference with click events.

requirements.summary: Optimize frontend performance to reduce response time and eliminate UI glitches, particularly focusing on form submission and list rendering operations
acceptanceCriteria: Form submissions complete within 2 seconds under normal conditions
UI updates render smoothly without flickering or layout shifts
Loading states are displayed during async operations
No visual glitches during list creation or dropdown population

file_operations.description: Add loading indicators (spinners or disabled states with loading text) to all buttons during mutation operations. Ensure isLoading states from mutation hooks are used to disable buttons and show feedback. Add optimistic UI updates where appropriate to make the interface feel more responsive. Prevent multiple simultaneous submissions by disabling buttons during pending operations.

Review React Query mutation configurations. Add appropriate retry logic and timeout settings. Ensure error handling is robust and doesn't leave the UI in a broken state. Consider adding optimistic updates for create operations to improve perceived performance.
Add loading states to all async operations. Ensure bulk username uploads show progress feedback. Add proper disabled states during operations to prevent race conditions or duplicate submissions.

requirements.summary: Clear the list name input field after successfully creating a new comment list to allow immediate creation of another list
acceptanceCriteria: Input field clears automatically after successful list creation
User can immediately enter a new list name without manual clearing
Form state resets properly after submission

file_operations.description: Add state management for the list name input field using useState. In the onSuccess callback of the createCommentList mutation, reset the input field state to an empty string. Ensure the input value is controlled by React state and bound to the state variable.
